messages:
anya: Heads up — console shows a spike in 'opaque_validation' counts on /generate route after last canary. Billing shows increased degen-route tokens. Anyone else seeing this?
sam: I see it. Looks like model-variant fallback path is returning partial JSON (missing 'result' key) and validator throws, then routing policy sends to degen route for safety.
lee: Can you paste sample payload?
anya: ```json
{
  "tool_call": null,
  "metadata": { "model_variant": "m-v2-quant" },
  "output": "{"text":"..."}"
}
``` <-- that's from the raw logs (sanitized)
dave: That output will fail our strict schema (expects object with result string + tools array). Current fallback increments 'reject_count' and triggers quota-routing, which the billing mappings treat as normal generation.
sam: So user gets charged twice? one for initial attempt, one for fallback?
lee: Yup. And console shows both attempts but grouped under different route IDs, so SRE alert fires twice.
anya: Proposal: add 'validation_cause' label to metrics (enum: schema_mismatch | parse_error | partial_ok) and tag route_id='fallback' only when we actually reroute. Add counter for 'validation_retries' so billing team can de-dupe.
dave: Also suggest keeping a sample of raw payload for debug but only sampled 1/1000 to avoid PII.
sam: UX question: how do we surface this in console? I think a per-route "validation breakdown" panel + breadcrumb linking to sampled payloads.
lee: +1. Also add an alert that only fires if de-duplicated token_billed_count increases by >10% over baseline.
anya: I'll draft a quick telemetry PR. PTAL: https://pr.redwood/infra/1234 (mock)
deploy-bot: deploy queued for infra/telemetry 12:05 UTC — will post status.
dave: If we change metrics we need a migration plan for dashboards and saved queries. I'll own that.
sam: Thanks — let's sync in infra sync at 16:00 if deploy goes through.
anya: thx :thumbsup:
